purpose: Dense toolbar action that can show an icon and label.

guidance.useWhen: Use inside repeated toolbars or compact command rows.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for standalone page-level primary actions.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Prefer ToolbarButton for dense repeated utility commands.

limitations: Keep the action label meaningful even when the visual presentation is compact.

accessibility.notes: Keep the label meaningful even when visual space is compact.
